uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1833-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
1833-6972-8095.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

240-3899-4785-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-1669-7893.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-7893.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-1669-7893.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2511-7084-7893.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

978-2420-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

907-2092-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
907-2092-4954.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-4359.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Mirrorhall Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

364-1987-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
364-1987-6991.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
364-1987-6991.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4390-5078-6757-7010-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-6757-7010-7633.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
4390-5078-6757-7010-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Gran-Gran.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

5232-5718-7487.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Zealous Lorecaster.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Zealous Lorecaster.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3992-7110.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent
1618-2440-3992-7110.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Stormchaser's Talent triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3992-7110.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1453-1903-2387-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-1903-2387-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

204-1858-2056-2633-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-7297.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-6559.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

3378-6333--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the extra turn spell and Illusionist's Stratagem each turn.
There are at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
3378-6333--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the extra turn spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.
3378-6333--88.notes: You must use an extra turn spell that will be put into your graveyard as it resolves, not exile or shuffling into your library.

1344-1506-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Nested Ghoul.
Nested Ghoul does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Nested Ghoul indestructible.
1344-1506-1636.description:
Give Nested Ghoul indestructible, if needed.
Activate Nested Ghoul by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Nested Ghoul triggers, creating a 2/2 Phyrexian Zombie creature token.
When the Phyrexian Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

1759-1850-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Akoum Refuge from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Akoum Refuge, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Akoum Refuge trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

372-1734-4605-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter until the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
When the nontoken Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Abdel Adrian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the token Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Abdel Adrian's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, choose not to exile a permanent.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the token Fiend Hunter and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

262-2178-5147.notablePrerequisites: Elemental Mastery and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature with power 1 or greater that does not have summoning sickness.
262-2178-5147.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, the creature with Thornbite Staff attached triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
If the creature has power 2 or greater, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

uses.n: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant

2129-5008.notablePrerequisites:
Scytheclaw attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with Scytheclaw attached.
2129-5008.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Scytheclaw attached.
Scytheclaw triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1525-2031-2406-2660-4284.notablePrerequisites:
Clone is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4284.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4284.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

401-4242-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
401-4242-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Decaying Soil.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2034-2757-2781-3582.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya's loyalty abilities have not been used this turn.
You control at least 1 basic land that can produce {W}.
2034-2757-2781-3582.description:
Activate Kaya's +1 loyalty ability to put a Ghostform Counter on Felidar Guardian.
Tap Felidar Guardian to untap your basic land.
Tap the basic land for {W}.
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Felidar Guardian is returned to your hand, and you create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Tap the Spirit token to untap the basic land.
Tap the basic land for {W}.
Sacrifice the Spirit token for {C}{C}.
Cast Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, exile Kaya and return her to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2665-3617-4477.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
2665-3617-4477.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the token Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
